notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
Time for our first update! Squished some bugs (thanks ve!), added Korean localization, and improved menu UI. We're working hard to make this app the best it can be, and appreciate all of your feedback. Keep a look out for updates as we continually improve the app and add new enhancements and features!
[list]
[*]Added Korean localization
[*]Renamed executable to match application name
[*]Improved collision on in-game objects
[*]Improved LOD settings
[*]Added fence to keep sheep in proper grazing area
[*]Improved menu UI (formatting and sizing)
[*]Improved teleportation mechanic
[*]Optimized sit/stand heights
[/list]
